map.State: Idle: CSS, Highlight: highlight, Pressed: runtime, not a prop

keys.about: Clusters and single codes to draw: "wasd arrows space shift" (the default), "numbers KeyF KeyR", "esc tab ctrl enter fkeys".

theme.about: boosty (cyan/magenta on black), dark or light. Any --tk-keyboard-* property overrides one colour.

highlight.about: Space-separated codes (or cluster names) to outline, e.g. "KeyW" or "KeyW Space".

pulse.about: Breathe the highlight (off under prefers-reduced-motion, `calm` and the kit's motion pause).

calm.about: No motion at all, whatever the OS says.

size.about: A multiple of the natural width (44px a key; 0.6) or any CSS length ("100%", "20rem"). Never wider than its container.

source.about: "live" reads keydown / keyup by position, "replay" plays a timeline; unset uses `state`.

capture.about: With source="live": also read keys while focus is in a field (ignored by default).

layout.about: "auto" shows the layout's own letters where the browser offers them; "us" always shows US caps.

labels.about: Your own cap letters by code, e.g. a game's key settings ({ KeyW: "z" }). They win over the browser's layout map.

label.about: Accessible name; defaults to the keys drawn ("Keyboard: W A S D (with Q and E), arrow keys, ...").

status.about: Show a one-line status (what the source is; never what was pressed).

state.about: Hand-fed state when there is no source: { pressed: ["KeyW", "ShiftLeft"] }.

replay.about: A createKeyReplay() result or { frames, map, hold }.

onKey.about: Called on every press and release from live input (not on auto-repeat).
